The reference lane is anchored by Vertiv as the obvious power/cooling leader. The discovery lane prioritizes less obvious U.S.-listed suppliers where the data-center bottleneck may appear through switchgear, engineered cooling systems, liquid-cooling scale-up, or field/electrical infrastructure services. This pass is research support only and does not make buy/sell recommendations. This pass expands the universe around data-center electrical and thermal balance-of-plant. The clean reference anchor remains Vertiv, but the more Serenity-relevant underfollowed lane points to vendors whose products or services sit one step away from GPUs: medium-voltage switchgear, packaged electrical systems, liquid/precision cooling, electrical infrastructure components, and grid-interconnection engineering.
